title: Supreme Court allows Trump to continue border wall construction in Big Bend region of Texas
text:

 News Finance More Mail Search the web Advertisement Advertisement Return to homepage Supreme Court allows Trump to continue border wall construction in Big Bend region of Texas
 John Fritze, CNN Mon, 9 November 2026 at 8:03 pm UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. An excavator plows through land during construction for a section of border wall near Santa Elena Canyon on August 14, 2026 in Big Bend National Park, Texas. - Brandon Bell/Getty Images The Supreme Court allowed President Donald Trump to continue border wall construction in the Big Bend region of Texas – including Big Bend National Park – on Monday, pausing a lower court ruling that temporarily blocked that work while it considers whether the administration had the authority to bypass environmental requirements.
 The court decided the case in an unsigned opinion . Liberal Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson was the only noted dissenter, but she did not explain her reasoning.
 The challengers "claim that construction in the Big Bend Sector will diminish their ability to use and enjoy the area," the court wrote. But Congress had enacted the law in a way that "reflects a clear preference for expeditious border construction over the very harms respondents assert."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The administration is attempting to speed construction of "300-plus" miles of border barrier and roads in the region. Relying on a federal law that gives the government the power to "waive all legal requirements" to ensure quick construction in areas of "high illegal entry," the Department of Homeland Security bypassed laws dealing with historic preservation, the environment and Native American artifacts that would normally apply.
 This story is breaking and will be updated.
